note: Isolating where interaction churn comes from. `pinned-4m` takes the point
cloud off the adaptive governor entirely — a fixed budget and a density
fraction of 1 — so whatever movement is left is selection and streaming
rather than quality. If churn largely disappears against `baseline`, the
`interaction-33` is here as the arm that can converge: the hysteresis band
at that target is 26.4 to 39.6 ms, which admits the 33.3 ms two-refresh
interval, where the default admits neither one refresh nor two. It is not
a proposal — it holds still by giving up 60 Hz, so read its frame rate
Companion to interaction-target.json, whose note describes the older
pre-display-quantum behaviour where the increase branch was unreachable.
